title: 第八章  不可思议的碾压
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

沈苍月此言一出，不要说其他人，就是叶落登时都瞪大了双眼，“沈老师，您是认真的吗，我才是炼体境界哎”，

一旁的凌海和穆琅直接笑喷了，就算是校长和一干老师的脸色都不太好，“沈老师，擂台之上可不是儿戏，生死可是常有的事，这小子要是穆琅不小心撞了，受伤了，我可不知道，你们可得自己负责。”

沈苍月一脸满不在乎，招呼着叶落过来在他耳边低语，“你能一战”，叶落眼睛一亮，“对啊，凭我现在的实力绝对能打得过御灵境，可问题是他还有一件斗铠”，

“无妨，区区灵级斗铠，很脆的”，“是吗”，叶落狐疑的望了沈苍月一眼，他可不觉得自己的拳头比吴旻的枪硬，但他还是选择相信了沈沧月，他相信沈苍月一定是有什么办法。

叶落直接走下看台，“穆琅，我实力为炼体九重，与你一战”，叶落也不是傻子，他之所以把自己的修炼境界说出来就是想让穆琅脱掉斗铠与他光明一战，没想到穆琅鸟都不鸟他。

沈苍月冷眼看了下凌海和穆琅，“哼，本来想让你们输的光明正大，但既然你们如此，就别怪我”，指尖一道蓝色灵力飞向穆琅的斗铠，

“开始！”裁判喊道；

叶铭此时此刻站在演武台上一脸懵逼，他什么武技也不会啊。

本来打算冲锋的穆琅也呆住了，演武台上，这人怎么站着不动，不对一定是为了迷惑他，想到这里，他抬起右臂狠狠得向叶铭冲了过去，秦月星此时的心砰砰直跳，她有灵级斗铠自然知道灵级斗铠的威力，虽然穆琅身上穿的是极其低端的灵级斗铠，但不管怎么说相对叶铭那也是极其危险的。

看到穆琅冲过来，叶落的身体里仿佛有什么东西活了过来，叶落的拳头上突然缭绕起了银色的雷光，与此同时，身体里的九个灵气气旋涌出金色灵力包裹在拳头上，

“喝！”

叶落一拳轰出，身形诡异般扭曲，避开了穆琅的一拳，而叶铭的一拳正中穆琅胸口，正当所有人被叶落奇迹般的身法震惊时，一道碎裂声轰然响起，本来不算大的炸裂声在众人耳中仿佛是一声炸雷，

“咔擦！”

所有人目瞪口呆，包括沈苍月，秦月星眸光一闪，“嗯？这不是青龙苍天拳吗？他怎么会？”

只见穆琅斗铠的胸甲已经几乎完全碎裂，但那个拳头上的金光和雷霆还未完全消散，突然，金光陡然一闪，

As soon as Shen Cangyue said these words, not to mention other people, even Ye Luodeng's eyes widened, "Teacher Shen, are you serious? I am in the realm of body refining."

Ling Hai and Mu Lang on the side burst into laughter. Even the principal and teacher Yi Qian looked unhappy, "Teacher Shen, being in the ring is not a child's play. Life and death are common things. If this kid is accidentally hit by Mu Lang and gets injured, I don't know. You have to be responsible for it yourself."

Shen Cangyue looked nonchalant, calling Ye Luo over and whispering in his ear, "You can fight." Ye Luo's eyes lit up, "Yes, with my current strength, I can definitely defeat the Yuling Realm, but the problem is that he still has a battle armor."

"It doesn't matter, it's just a spirit-level battle armor. It's very brittle." "Really?" Ye Luo glanced at Shen Cangyue suspiciously. He didn't think that his fist was stronger than Wu Min's gun, but he still chose to believe in Shen Cangyue. He believed that Shen Cangyue must have some solution.

Ye Luo walked directly down the stand and said, "Mu Lang, my strength is at the ninth level of body refining. I will fight with you." Ye Luo was not a fool. The reason why he revealed his cultivation level was because he wanted Mu Lang to take off his armor and fight with him. Unexpectedly, Mu Lang wouldn't ignore him.

Shen Cangyue looked at Ling Hai and Mu Lang coldly, "Humph, I originally wanted you to lose in an honest manner, but since you are like this, don't blame me." A blue spiritual power flew towards Mu Lang's battle armor from her fingertips.

"Start!" the referee shouted;

Ye Ming was standing on the martial arts stage with a confused face at this moment. He didn't know any martial arts skills.

Mu Lang, who was planning to charge, was also stunned. Why was this man standing still on the martial arts stage? It must be to confuse him. Thinking of this, he raised his right arm and rushed towards Ye Ming. Qin Yuexing's heart was pounding at this time. She has a spirit-level battle armor and naturally knows the power of a spirit-level battle armor. Although Mu Lang is wearing an extremely low-end spirit-level battle armor, it is extremely dangerous to Ye Ming anyway.

Seeing Mu Lang rushing over, something in Ye Luo's body seemed to come alive. Silver lightning suddenly shone around Ye Luo's fist. At the same time, the nine spiritual energy cyclones in his body surged out and wrapped golden spiritual power around his fist.

"Drink!"

Ye Luo punched out, his body twisted strangely, avoiding Mu Lang's punch, and Ye Ming's punch hit Mu Lang's chest. Just when everyone was shocked by Ye Luo's miraculous movement, a shattering sound boomed. The originally not big explosion sound was like a thunder in everyone's ears.

"Kacha!"

Everyone was stunned, including Shen Cangyue, and Qin Yuexing's eyes flashed, "Huh? Isn't this Qinglong Cangtian Fist? How could he do it?"

I saw that the breastplate of Mu Lang's battle armor was almost completely shattered, but the golden light and thunder on the fist had not completely dissipated. Suddenly, there was a sudden flash of golden light,
